### CVE-2024-53034 — Untrusted Pointer Dereference in DSP_Services
- Assigner: qualcomm | Published: 2025-03-03 | Updated: 2026-02-26 | Max CVSS: 7.8

- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 7.8 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:L/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`
